hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/westmoreland ('Accepts outlets for 20 and 30-amp current'; 'EW - Electric and water hookups, various equipment, RVs of up to 40 feet ... Campgrounds A and B'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Campgrounds A, B and C, all site-specific: EW 42 (A and B), Std no-hookup 74 (A, B, C), both taking RVs to 40 ft; plus one group tent site and three Buddy group sites. Two vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/westmoreland ('EW - ... RVs of up to 40 feet'; 'Std - No hookups, various equipment. RVs of up to 40 feet'; 'Total sites of each type : EW, 42; Std, 74; GrpTentStd, 1; Buddy, 3'; 'Total campsites : 133'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathhouses with showers; laundry in the Campground A bathhouse. Camp store (camping and picnic supplies) with seasonal hours; Wi-Fi only at the camp store, cell service limited. Firewood sold at the park.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/westmoreland ('Laundry facilities in Campground A bathhouse'; 'Use Campground A bathhouse for bathroom and showers'; 'Camp store: Camping and picnic supplies and gift items are available'; 'WiFi is available at the camp store'; amenities list 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First Friday in March through the first Monday in December.

season.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/westmoreland ('Camping is available from the first Friday in March until the first Monday in December.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the season on the park's own page and fees as human-checked 2026-10-12 ($27 Std no-hookup sites take RVs to 40 ft, so the base stands; $37 E/W). Added 30-amp with water at the 42 EW sites, 133 sites to 40 ft, showers/laundry/dump/camp store/Wi-Fi at the store. Campgrounds A-C open; cabins and the paddle-in site closed for renovation (to ~May 2027), which does not affect the campground. Booking left inherited.
